scientific.integrity: The primary article was inspected at the model equations, algebraic constraint, initial assumptions, numerical parameter set, and Figure 6. Related singular bioeconomic predator-prey literature was compared to delimit the claim to the source-specific feasibility barrier. The bundled exact-arithmetic checker replays the parameter diagnostics; the barrier proof is analytic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns finite continuous classical trajectories of the printed differential-algebraic system and the interpretation of Figure 6. It does not inspect unavailable simulation code, does not audit unrelated bifurcation calculations, and does not rule out extinction under a different harvesting closure or regime-switching model.

title: A hard prey-feasibility barrier in a harvested herd-behavior predator-prey DAE
